h1: Interior design project for a 43 m² duplex apartment

blocks.text: Interior design project for a 43 m² duplex apartment

parts.html: In this project, the interior design studio DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) carried out the full scope of work: interior design, technical documentation, design and manufacture of bespoke furniture, and turnkey renovation. The design covered every room: the living room, bedroom, kitchen with custom interior fittings and built-in appliances, walk-in closets, entrance hall, bathroom, wardrobes, and shelving. Furniture was custom-designed for each area. Before the renovation began, the client received a detailed cost estimate for labor, construction materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and more. 3D visualizations, photos, and video of the completed project are presented.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — we create interiors that truly come to life.
